title: Retry with exponential backoff
prompt:
Calls to the payment provider fail now and then. Implement the `retry` decorator in app/retry.py: it retries the
wrapped function when it raises one of `exceptions` (default `(Exception,)`), up to `attempts` calls in total, waiting
`base_delay * 2**n` seconds before the n-th retry (n from 0), capped at `max_delay`. The sleep function is injectable
(`sleep=time.sleep`) so tests do not wait. Other exceptions propagate at once; after the last attempt the last error is
re-raised. The wrapped function keeps its name and docstring.
